entries.value: reads a room in three breaths
remembers faces and the lies told with them
repairs anything mechanical with a hairpin
can imitate any accent for one sentence
finds the one person at a party who needs to leave
keeps a ledger of debts in her head
makes ordinary food taste like an occasion
draws a map of any building after one walk
whistles through her teeth to call animals
lies so plainly that people believe her
sings harmony without knowing the tune
works out how a machine fails before it does
waits without fidgeting, which unnerves people
